bread.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
bread.cmd.master.tip: Master switch for every Bread feature
bread.cmd.info.tip: See what Bread is skipping right now
bread.cmd.fps.tip: Show or hide the FPS counter
bread.cmd.coords.tip: Show or hide your coordinates, facing and biome
bread.cmd.no_toggle: There is no on/off setting called %s.
bread.cmd.no_number: There is no number setting called %s.
bread.info.off: Bread is %s, so it is not skipping anything right now.
bread.info.title: Bread info
bread.info.subtitle: %s FPS · last frame
bread.master.on: Bread is %s. Every feature uses its own setting again.
bread.master.off: Bread is %s. Everything runs like vanilla until you turn it back on.
bread.config.right_click_harvest.desc: Right-click a grown crop to harvest and replant it.
bread.config.double_doors.desc: Double doors open and close together.
bread.config.ladder_extend.desc: Click a ladder with a ladder to extend it down (or up when you look up).
bread.config.bone_meal_cane_and_cactus.d: Bone meal grows sugar cane and cactus by one block.
bread.config.shovel_path_to_dirt.desc: Right-click a dirt path or farmland with a shovel to turn it back into dirt.
bread.config.leash_villagers.desc: Villagers and wandering traders can be put on a lead.
bread.config.feather_falling_saves_crops: Boots with Feather Falling do not trample farmland.
bread.config.snow_golem_pumpkin.desc: Put a carved pumpkin back on a sheared snow golem.
bread.config.hide_unseen.desc: Skip drawing mobs, chests, signs and frames fully behind walls (checked on a spare thread).
bread.config.decor_entity_distance.desc: Blocks away to stop drawing item frames, paintings and armor stands. 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.dropped_item_distance.desc: Blocks away to stop drawing dropped items and XP orbs. 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.sign_distance.desc: Blocks away to stop drawing signs, banners and heads. 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.background_fps.desc: FPS limit while the game window is not focused. 0 = no limit.
bread.config.far_mob_detail_distance.des: Blocks away to stop drawing armor and held items on mobs (not players). 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.item_pile_distance.desc: Blocks away to draw a dropped stack as one item instead of a pile. 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.max_particles.desc: Most particles of one kind at once (vanilla allows 16384). 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.flat_item_distance.desc: Blocks away to draw dropped and framed items flat, without their pixel edges. 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.name_tag_distance.desc: Blocks away to stop drawing name tags of mobs (not players). 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.glint_distance.desc: Blocks away to stop drawing the enchantment shimmer on items. 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.fast_dropped_items.desc: Your game skips entity collision checks for dropped items and XP orbs (the server still does them).
bread.config.item_merge_radius.desc: Server: how close dropped items merge into one stack (vanilla 0.5). 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.xp_merge_radius.desc: Server: how close XP orbs merge into one orb (vanilla 0.5). 0 = vanilla.
bread.config.fps_counter.desc: Show your FPS in a corner of the screen.
bread.config.coordinates.desc: Show your coordinates, facing and biome under the FPS counter's corner.
bread.config.fps_counter_corner.desc: Where the FPS counter sits: top_left, top_right, bottom_left or bottom_right.
bread.config.zoom.desc: Hold the zoom key (C, change it in Controls) to look closer.
bread.config.zoom_level.desc: How many times closer the zoom starts.
bread.config.zoom_scroll.desc: Scroll while zooming to zoom further in or out.
bread.config.zoom_smooth.desc: Ease the zoom in and out instead of snapping.
